If you don’t remember your email, you can provide your first name, last name, and zip code instead. Once authenticated, I’ll check your order details and see what options are available.

I actually don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Chen Smith and my zip code is 32278. Can you please check my order and help me undo the cancellation? I really need everything from that order delivered as soon as possible.

Thank you for providing your information. I have located your account. To proceed, could you please provide the order ID of the cancelled order you want to restore? Once I have the order ID, I will check its status and let you know what options are available. 

Please note that once an order is cancelled, it usually cannot be undone, but I will confirm the details for you.

I’m in a bit of a hurry and don’t have the order ID handy right now. Is there any way you can look up my most recent cancelled order under my name and zip code?
